label: kizuna_head_a_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh? Why hello,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_02
text: How is your Treasure Hunt coming along?\nHaving all sorts of fun adventures, I hope?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_select_01
text: Yeah, it’s been great!

label: kizuna_head_a_select_02
text: It’s not going so well...

label: kizuna_head_a_03a
text: Wonderful. I’m glad to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_03b
text: Oh my. Is that so...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_04
text:
Do keep in mind that the Treasure Hunt has no
set course or criteria you must follow.\c
Simply go where your heart takes you, and you
shall do splendidly.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_05
text: Speaking of such pursuits, there has been\nsomething on my mind of late.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_06
text: If I could ask for your expertise on the matter,\nI would be most grateful.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_07
text: You see, I recently heard a word whose meaning\nescapes me. I believe it to be some sort of slang.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_08
text: Tell me, what does “cheugy” mean?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_select_03
text: Something super cool

label: kizuna_head_a_select_04
text: Being outdated and uncool

label: kizuna_head_a_select_05
text: It’s a really chewy gumball

label: kizuna_head_a_09a
text: I see! So one might say, “Today’s lesson was the\ncheugiest!” Is that right?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_09b
text: Ah... I think I understand. For both speaker and\nrecipient, it is not a pleasant word, I take it...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_09c
text:
A...very chewy gumball? So it is some sort of
confection that children are partial to recently?\c
I shall have to try one of these “cheugies” for
myself sometime.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_10
text:
The words used by young people these days are
quite often beyond my comprehension.\c
But when I learn the meanings behind the words,
I find that I feel that much closer to my students.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_11
text: I am most grateful to you for your help on\nthat front.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_head_a_system
text: You became slightly closer with Director Clavell!
